body:
_Migrated from issue #899, filed 2026-07-14._

Two related diagnostics gaps, both raised in #873.

## Nothing is logged about the token or whether Hardcover is on

`cps/schedule.py` has no logger at all — no import, no `log.` call anywhere in the file:

```python
# schedule.py:251-255
enabled = bool(cwa_settings.get("hardcover_auto_fetch_enabled", False))
token_available = bool(config.resolved_hardcover_token())
if not enabled or not token_available:
    return                      # silent; the two causes are indistinguishable
...
# schedule.py:311-313
except Exception:
    pass                        # every scheduling error swallowed
```

Three different causes — disabled, no token, exception — all produce the same observable: nothing. `resolved_hardcover_token()` and `token_status()` (`cps/services/hardcover.py:34`) never log either.

Worth noting for anyone debugging this: the job is only added (`schedule.py:310`) after the `:254` gate passes, so `Added job "hardcover auto-fetch" to job store "default"` does prove the token resolved and auto-fetch is enabled. That is currently the only signal, and it is accidental rather than designed.

Suggested fix: add a logger to `schedule.py`; one `log.info` per branch at `:254` saying which condition failed; log token presence and source at resolve time; replace `except Exception: pass` with `log.exception`.

## The source is a boolean, so file users are told the wrong variable

`hardcover_token_from_env()` (`cps/config_sql.py:441-452`) returns `bool(env or file)`. The note at `config_edit.html:284` then hardcodes "A token from the **HARDCOVER_TOKEN environment variable** is currently active" — so someone who set `HARDCOVER_TOKEN_FILE` is pointed at a variable they never set.

Suggested fix: return a source enum (`db` / `env` / `file` / none) from one resolver and let the template and the log lines name the variable actually in use.

Privacy invariant for both halves: presence and source only, never the value. `config_hardcover_token` is on the debug-bundle redaction list (`cps/debug_info.py:51`) and filtered by the `token not in k.lower()` rule (`cps/config_sql.py:409`).

Credit: @KucharczykL (#873).
title: Hardcover: log token presence + source, and distinguish HARDCOVER_TOKEN from HARDCOVER_TOKEN_FILE
